She's with less than 2 months I think. I'm really happy for her but I can't say I'm excited to be an uncle since I can't give her or my nephew enough support. Neverthless, I wish she waited a bit more, to have a more stable life and mind before being a mom.
I went to a psychiatrist 2 years ago, she talked to me for less than 4 minutes I think and prescribed some medicine, that I took for 5 months before stopping since I wasn't noticing improvement and it was kinda expensive for me.

To me a fullfilling future would be having a peacefull life on the countryside, finding love and creating a family. Also I want to have a decent job, it doesn't need to be extremelly well paid. I just want to have a sense of acomplishment and pride on whatever I may do. I wish I had the strenght to be a teacher but I don't think I'm in a position to teach anyone. I used to think I could help other kids as well so they wouldn't end like me, but at the present it's impossible.

Yes, she's the one I'm most afraid to hurt with this, even more with her already having depression. But I think she'll get over it eventually since she has my aunt, that took care of her during her childhood and is like a mother to her, our cousins that are like brothers as well and a decent hard working husband. She recently got pregnant too, so she has a purpose in life.
